text:
anya: Heads-up — after the int8 quant bring-up we saw embedding recall drop ~7% on the anchor/golden set. Anyone else seeing this?
liam: saw similar in offline eval earlier today, degradation concentrated on short queries (<=12 tokens) and exact-match retrievals.
maria: which eval run and model variant? int8 vs q4?
anya: run id eval/2026-03-18/emb-run-08, model=redwood-13b-quant8, config: prefix_cache=false, norm=none. Metrics: recall@10, mrr. CLI we used: `rwi eval run --id emb-run-08 --dataset prompt-anchors-v2 --metrics recall@10,mrr`.
santhosh: tagging @labeler-bot to re-sample the golden set with stratified hard negatives so we can see if it's a data shift vs quantization artifact.
labeler-bot: scheduled job 3482: sample 200 anchors + 600 negatives (strata: short/long/query-type) — ETA 45m.
jordan: i can pull 150 extra hard negatives from recent logs (failed-rerank bucket). I'll upload to /datasets/ingest/emb-hard-20260318.csv by EOD.
maria: quick ask — before relabeling we should de-dupe anchors against the new negatives. Last time we had fuzzy overlaps causing label noise. Suggest fingerprinting: fnv64(url+text) + token-overlap threshold 0.7 with wordpiece-based tokenization.
liam: agreed. small note: when we de-dupe, keep the short-query originals if conflict — they tend to be signal for recall.
anya: can we also add a small golden-only relabel pass (N=300) with 3 annotators to compute kappa? want to measure assessor consistency after quant change.
maria: I can own the QC pass. Plan: create `golden_relabel_v3.jsonl`, assign cohort=embed-golden, annotators=[alex, priya, marco], priority=high. Will run kappa and surface disagreements >1 label.
santhosh: also add a lightweight embedding-similarity check: cosine drop >0.12 vs baseline -> mark as suspect. That helps triage whether quantization shifts embedding geometry.
eval-bot: regression alert: recall@10 -6.9% vs baseline on prompt-anchors-v2 (190/200 anchors flagged for review). Full diff: https://rwi.eval/compare/emb-run-07...emb-run-08
anya: thanks. action items: 1) jordan export hard negatives, 2) labeler-bot resample & de-dupe using fnv64+0.7 overlap, 3) maria run 3x annotator golden relabel and compute kappa, 4) santhosh run cosine-drop triage script and surface top 50 suspects.
maria: will create the golden JSONL and post a short labeling guide (anchors vs near-duplicates, edge-case instructions). Will ping ops for extra labeler capacity if needed.
liam: i'll re-run eval with prefix_cache=true as ablation (quick check) and post results in this thread.
anya: perfect — timeline: aim for preliminary triage + relabel pass by tomorrow 4pm PT. If anyone hits blockers ping me or escalate to eng-oncall.
jordan: uploading hard negatives now (38MB) -> /datasets/ingest/emb-hard-20260318.csv :thumbsup:
labeler-bot: job 3482 completed: 800 samples placed in /work/label/emb-sample-3482. De-dupe log: 58 duplicates removed.
maria: starting labeling now, will post progress.
anya: thanks team — let's reconvene here when we have the relabel + cosine triage. :eyes:
